segments.summary: Reviewed the versioned root plus ledger, referential-integrity, project-context, PRD intake, Planning Wizard, compile, WorkNode, and activation contracts. Strong fail-closed receipts and security gates coexist with material gaps in idempotency collision handling, snapshot atomicity, state machines, stage/wave protocol, and exactly-once delivery mechanics.

Reviewed testing records and policies, every UI command contract, all clean-room scenarios, and retired exclusions. The lane is explicit that static fixtures are not runtime proof, but evidence lifecycle, GUI read-model truth, crash/race scenarios, and retirement migration metadata remain underdefined.
